title: Threads to a rock
hook: An animal can anchor without roots.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The revealed fibers link the mussel to the rock. Many mussels attach by byssal threads; the diagram simplifies their number and composition and does not demonstrate how much force they withstand.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: A mussel attaches to a rock by a bundle of fibers it produces. What are these attachment fibers called?
